TREK TOP FUEL 5.5

1.450 € VB

Are you looking for an extremely powerful, fast and agile downcountry trail bike without having to pay the full new price? This Trek Top Fuel 5 Gen 3 in Satin Lithium Grey is in an absolutely new condition. It was only used 6 to 7 times for light, relaxed rides and was otherwise protected in the dry - no bike park, no falls or hard trails.
The frame, the components and the tires have practically no wear. The bike climbs extremely efficiently uphill and at the same time offers maximum safety and riding fun downhill.

Most important features & equipment

• Frame size: M/L (Medium/Large) - ideal for a body height of approx. 173 cm to 180 cm.
• Frame: Alpha Platinum aluminium with internally installed cables, integrated down tube protection and integrated storage compartment in the frame.
• Adjustable geometry: Equipped with Treks Mino Link system to customize the steering angle and bottom bracket height to your riding style.
• Suspension fork: RockShox Recon Silver RL, Solo Air air spring, Motion Control cushioning, 130 mm travel.
• Shock: X-Fusion Pro 2, 2-position damping, 120 mm travel.
• Drive: Reliable Shimano Deore M6100 1x12-speed gearshift with wide gear ratio for effortless climbs.
• Brakes: Shimano hydraulic disc brakes for maximum and safe braking power in any weather.
• Wheels & Tires: Alex MD35 Tubeless Ready rims with grippy Bontrager XR4 Team Issue Tubeless Ready tires.
• Seatpost: TranzX Vario seatpost (Dropper Post) with internal cable routing - can be lowered from the handlebars at the push of a button for full control in the descent.

Condition & Sales Details

• Condition: Technically and optically 10/10. The gearshift is crisp, the brakes are immediately gripping and the chassis works flawlessly. After the few trips always cleaned and maintained - ready for use immediately for the next tour!
• Price: 1,450
• Location: 63450 Hanau
• Processing: Only to self-collectors. An on-site inspection is expressly desired so that you can convince yourself of the immaculate condition.
Please send messages in English if possible. Pick up by prior arrangement.
Extras: Montage full Bicycle Cover soft case, tyre repair kit, bottle holder
